question: For each enrollment, show the client id, the program code and the name of the program.
reply:
```sql
SELECT e.client_id, e.program_code, p.name AS program_name
FROM people.enrollment AS e
JOIN org.program AS p
  ON p.agency_id = e.agency_id
 AND p.program_code = e.program_code
ORDER BY e.client_id, e.program_code
```
